_doc: Per-app Google Play release settings, read by tools/aab.mjs, tools/play-metadata.mjs and .github/workflows/play-yukle.yml. Package names (applicationId) are permanent once an app exists in Play Console: never change them. Optional source: the Vite app the Play build ships when it is not games/<slug> (okcu ships the 3D renderer apps/okcu-3d). Guide: docs/production/play-yayin.md. ios: the App Store build (tools/ipa.mjs): bundle id = applicationId, version = CFBundleShortVersionString, gameCenter.boards = logical board id → App Store Connect leaderboard id (create them with exactly these ids).
